title: Chapter 1875: Taking Action (I)
content:
Chapter 1875: Taking Action (I)

Having settled his arrangements, Li Ximing sat cross-legged with his eyes closed and spent some time refining pills in the mountains, light and shadow intertwining around him. Before long, a warm wind swept in. Golden light faintly illuminated the formation, and the jade pendant at his waist began radiating heat.

Minghuang is here!

A smile immediately appeared on his face, and he rose on a streak of light. Sure enough, the clouds parted to reveal a young man descending through the air in black robes patterned with gold. His long hair was tied back, giving his face an imposing demeanor. A pale-white scroll hung at his waist, and his piercing golden eyes exuded a fearsome intensity.

Daoist Master Baoxiang had been quicker, as she continued rising into the air ahead of him. She cultivated Pit Water, which was poorly compatible with Bright Yang. A single glance set her divine ability warning her incessantly, filling her with an unprecedented sense of danger. Respect and apprehension mingled on her face.

Seeing Li Ximing approach, she hurriedly stepped back and said, "So it is the King of Wei..."

Li Ximing laughed, shook out his sleeves, and introduced Baoxiang before leading Li Zhouwei inside. She hurriedly said, "Please forgive me for not coming farther out to welcome you..."

During his stay, Li Ximing had learned that Baoxiang belonged to roughly the same generation as Jiangqian and the others. Calling herself a junior was hardly mere courtesy. He smiled and led them into the mountain. After a few pleasantries, she tactfully withdrew to let the two speak privately.

Li Ximing said, "Everything is arranged, and I have some good news as well."

Li Zhouwei smiled inquiringly. "

Oh?

"

Li Ximing raised his brows. "An elderly rogue cultivator surnamed Yú lives at the edge of the Western Sea, beside the Abyss of Inferior Water. He urgently needs a [Jeweled Heart Profound Swan Pill]. Hearing I was here, he came all this way to find me. He told me... he possesses a [Clear Profound Coffin]."

A thoughtful expression crossed his face. "Apparently, it is a Mansion Water spirit item, neither particularly well known nor widely useful. It came from a cave dwelling in the Western Sea. But the good thing is... there is more than one portion."

He sighed. "I thought the Western Sea must have something to offer, being one of the Four Seas. Yet after traveling around, I can only call it barren. It is merely better off than Scarlet Pristine Sea, with somewhat more spirit items of Mansion Water. The conditions are harsh, and everyone schemes against everyone else. Apart from a few exceptionally powerful figures, most Purple Mansion Realm cultivators will not leave their own lineage's territory.

"After all, these wielders of divine abilities cannot even afford to build Purple Mansion Realm formations. They can only band together and resort to sordid methods to obtain spirit materials. As for Purple Mansion Realm spirit items... most are found in ancient cave dwellings.

"This particular cave dwelling only appeared a few years ago. The spirit item had been embedded in its great formation. There were five portions in total, divided among five Daoist Masters."

By now, Li Zhouwei had understood what he was alluding to and finished, "Since there is more than one portion, and these Mansion Water spirit items only came into those Daoist Masters' possession recently... you're thinking of using the [Supplementary Court Verdant Profound Cauldron], granduncle."

Li Ximing nodded with a smile. "The beauty of it is... Abbot Shehu also has a portion of [Clear Profound Coffin]. Rogue Cultivator Yú is willing to trade his to me. Of the others, one is with Daoist Master Baoxiang, and another is with Rogue Cultivator Yinxin, who will be helping us shortly.

"We don't need to obtain all four. Even with three, placing them in the spirit artifact to be nurtured and refined for a few years should certainly yield a portion of spirit water!"

Li Zhouwei nodded thoughtfully. Li Ximing grew serious. "I also learned that [Clear Profound Coffin] is said to form within [Profound Coffin Crimson Water]. If we can refine it back into [Profound Coffin Crimson Water], that would be extraordinary...

"This [Profound Coffin Crimson Water] is a treasure of Water and Wood found in lakes. It possesses both the wonders of transformation and the virtue of nourishment. Whether for refining spirit artifacts, constructing precious formations, or even practicing arts... it is immensely useful."

Li Zhouwei merely nodded in acknowledgment before changing the subject. "This Shehu... how capable is he?"

Li Ximing smiled and shook his head. "I made careful inquiries. He has two [Orthodox Wood] divine abilities, neither of them a Fate Divine Ability. With my [Heavenly Crow Merging Fire], I doubt he could even defeat me!"

After considering the matter, he sighed. "But our helper, Rogue Cultivator Yinxin, will be facing [Western Mansion Origin Grotto Gate]. The risk is considerable. There is at least Chixi, who is in the middle stage of the Purple Mansion Realm, and there may be others at the mountain gate. So he has named his price... If we succeed, he wants half of everything Shehu possesses."

Seeing Li Zhouwei frown, Li Ximing explained seriously, "He is the only Western Sea cultivator willing to act, and he will take responsibility for the affair. No one else will do that. This way, it can be treated as though he invited us here. [Western Mansion Origin Grotto Gate] is flourishing... It would be better to let him offend them and bear that risk, keeping Moongaze Lake out of it."

This consideration for the clan's future earned Li Zhouwei's nod. Recalling the information he had received before departing, he understood.

So this is it. Even in a remote place like the Western Sea, Shehu has secretly kept a spirit root. This Rogue Cultivator Yinxin must have discovered it and long wanted to kill him for it, lacking only the opportunity. Everyone has their own schemes.

As he pondered, a faint sound came from the mountain amid glowing colored light. Daoist Master Daomian had returned. He stopped before the steps and gazed at Li Zhouwei with an unusual expression. "Greetings, King of Wei!"

Light flickered in his pupils, suggesting he had practiced some unusual art. He bowed slightly and only straightened after Li Zhouwei acknowledged him, then smiled. "Congratulations, Zhaojing! Fellow Daoist Xie was overjoyed by the good news. He insisted on addressing Fellow Daoist Yan as his elder, and has already settled his affairs in the Western Sea and headed east."

Curiosity lingered on Daomian's face. Clearly, he did not know what Yan Dushui could possibly offer to persuade Xiehu to leave so easily. Li Ximing, however, was unsurprised. Rising, he said with a smile, "As for your acquaintance, Rogue Cultivator Yinxin..."

Daoist Master Daomian brought his hands together. "I have already spoken with him. He is only waiting for your word, fellow Daoist!"

"Good! Everything is in place!"

Li Ximing nodded with a smile, stepped outside, and invited Guo Nanwu over. He explained to the others, "Abbot Shehu has three helpers in all. Daoist Master Xiehu has left and cannot assist him. Rogue Cultivator Yinxin will hold off Chixi, the middle stage Purple Mansion Realm cultivator of Western Mansion Origin Grotto Gate. Nanwu will handle the demonic creature in Fangyazhou."

Guo Nanwu nodded in acceptance, and Daoist Master Daomian nodded with evident satisfaction. Li Ximing continued, "He may have other helpers we do not know of. To guard against any surprises, the King of Wei and I will subdue this fiend together!"

With his current divine abilities, Li Zhouwei stood second only to Grand Daoist Masters. Li Ximing's arrangements were cautious indeed.

Delay could invite complications. Without the slightest hesitation, Li Ximing rose on the wind with the others and entered the great void. The three departed, while Daoist Master Daomian took out a jade talisman and gently crushed it to signal Rogue Cultivator Yinxin.

Only then did the woman in Daoist robes enter from outside. She took a few steps through the courtyard as Daoist Master Daomian sighed. "People often call mainland cultivators rigid, yet every one I meet proves extraordinary. Even without Yan Dushui, their wealth in the heart of the realm would make it easy to summon a middle stage Purple Mansion Realm cultivator to deal with Xiehu. But the way they handled him... shows just how adept these Orthodox Dao cultivators are at preening their feathers and preserving their reputations."

Baoxiang, who knew Jiangnan better, smiled. "The mainland has many rules. Dealing with opponents as they have just dealt with Xiehu plays to the Orthodox Dao's strengths. My master once said, 'The true skill lies in harnessing what is upright.' Anyone can act without scruples. Who among those who attain divine abilities lacks a ruthless streak?

"It is less a matter of exceptional personal ability than of his position amid the world's great affairs. He has the resources and information to bring others into play..."

Daoist Master Daomian seemed to recall something. Profound desolation and despair settled over his aged face, and he spoke tearfully. "Easy to say, difficult to do... We stay away from the mainland and its struggles, living freely in the Western Sea without those great figures constraining us. Certainly, we take pride in that, but when the moment comes... we may not even understand what killed us.

"That is precisely what brought my [Mercury Circulation Terrace] low!"
